items.title: Alagang PDH Ako Stories: More Than a Hospital: A Second Home Built on Trust and Care
items.excerpt: At Parañaque Doctors Hospital, care goes beyond medicine. It’s about building trust, offering comfort, and creating a second home for families facing life’s toughest challenges.

items.title: Neuro Talk Kick-Off: Empowering Barangay Napindan with Life-Saving Knowledge
items.excerpt: PDH took an important step toward community health empowerment with the Kick-Off: Neuro Talk at Barangay Napindan, led by neurologist Dr. Aubrey Punzalan, on stroke awareness and prevention.

items.title: IM Family Health Talk Kick-Off: Building Stronger Families, One Health Talk at a Time
items.excerpt: PDH launched its IM Family Health Talk in Barangay Upper Bicutan, led by Dr. Keith Darryl Deo Grafil, with a focus on dengue awareness and healthy lifestyle habits.

items.title: Keeping Hearts Healthy: PDH’s Cardiovascular Health Talk Brings Awareness to the Community
items.excerpt: On March 20, 2025, PDH hosted a Cardiovascular Health Talk led by Dr. Paul Quetua, Internal Medicine Specialist, with Barangay Marcelo Green and Barangay Don Bosco.

items.title: Parenting 101: Because Every Child Deserves the Best Start!
items.excerpt: On March 17, 2025, Parañaque Doctors Hospital hosted a parenting talk for the community.

items.title: PDH Buntis Day 2025: Nurturing Mothers, Strengthening Communities
items.excerpt: On March 10, 2025, Parañaque Doctors Hospital held PDH Buntis Day for expectant mothers.

items.title: Alagang PDH Ako Stories: A Mother’s Journey of Hope and Healing
items.excerpt: For Jennifer Danao, January 2025 was a time of worry, uncertainty, and ultimately, gratitude, marked by the dedication of the medical professionals who saved her six-year-old son.

items.title: Alagang PDH Barangay Partnership
items.excerpt: At Parañaque Doctors Hospital, we believe that quality healthcare starts at the grassroots, through partnerships with barangay leaders and local communities.

items.title: Every Drop Counts: PDH Bloodletting Drive Saves Lives
items.excerpt: Parañaque Doctors Hospital hosted a bloodletting drive to help save lives.

items.title: Importance of Regular Check-ups
items.excerpt: Have you been hearing about regular check-ups? Here’s why they matter.
